title: WPSS/611/2005 of LALIT CHANDRA Vs CHIEF GENERAL MANAGER and ANR.

paras.text:
HIGH COURT OF UTTARANCHAL AT NAINITAL
Writ Petition No. 611 of 2005 (SS)
Lalit Chandra ................... Petitioner.
Versus
1. Chief General Manager, Uttaranchal Jal
 Sansthan, Dehradun.
2. General Manager, Kumaon Division,
 Uttaranchal Jal Sansthan, Nainital.
3. Director Treasury & Finance Services
 Uttaranchal, Dehradun
Sri P.C. Bisht, Advocate for the petitioner.
Sri J.P. Joshi, Advocate for the respondents.
Dated: 19.5.2005
Hon'ble Rajesh Tandon, J.
 Heard the leaned counsel for the parties.
 By the present writ petition, the petitioner has prayed for
a writ of mandamus directing the respondents to make payment
of retirement benefits due to late Sri Nathu Lal to the petitioner.
 Briefly stated, the father of the petitioner late Sri Nathu
Lal was working as Khallasi in Uttaranchal Jal Sansthan,
Bhowali, District Nainital. He retired after completing the age
of susperannuation on 31.7.2002. The father of the petitioner
made several representations to the respondents but only a sum
of Rs. 35,000/- as interim gratuity was paid to him. His father
died on 21.11.2004 leaving behind three sons in the family. The
petitioner also made representations to the respondents but till

today no amount towards the retirement benefits of his father
was paid to the family.
 Sri J.P. Joshi, counsel for the respondents has not
disputed the right of the petitioner for availing the retirement
benefits of late Sri Nathu Lal and submitted that directions may
be made to the Director Treasury and Finance Services,
Uttaranchal who is liable to pay retirement benefits to the
petitioner.
 In view of the above, the respondents are directed to pay
the outstanding amount of retirement benefits of late Sri Nathu
Lal to his legal heirs within three months after the receipt of the
certified copy of this order and after completing the usual
formalities, if not completed as yet.
 Accordingly, the writ petition is allowed. There will be no
order as to costs.
Rajesh Tandon, J.
19.5.2005
*Dhyani
